items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: The other one, Kingston, by his name.

ctx.x: No. I think I got the wood block here. When I got here. There was the four wood blocks on top. I got the blocks here. I think I did. I'm not sure. Yeah, I had the blocks, but I got the blocks. That didn't come with the set. I got the blocks here. We used to use them every time they would block. They were right sure. That's right. You used them four cowbells. Four cowbells. Now the cowbells came with the drums. That's what came with the drums. The cowbells, yeah. Was it a set of four cowbells?

Four, yeah. It was a set of four. Yes. They had four. The next size, the next size, the next size. That's right. We always had called him Alexis. I couldn't find him. Who is that? Alexis, Rickard's brother. You know. You used to call Rickard, Rickard. The other one, Kingston, by his name. But when he was taught by the drum, he always said Alexis.
Yes, he still don't know his first name. He said Alexis, yeah.
